item.description: GTA 6 will launch on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game was initially scheduled for a late 2025 release but was subsequently delayed. A PC version is expected at a later date.

item.title: Google developing Android Fast Switch to rival Apple's iPhone Handoff? Share one phone number across two devices
item.description: Google may be developing Android Fast Switch, a feature that would let users share one phone number across two Android smartphones. Unfinished code suggests the mobile connection would move to whichever phone is unlocked, provided both devices use the same Google account

item.title: Apple iPhone 18 launch tipped for 2027: Same screen size and battery as iPhone 18e? What we know so far
item.description: A leak suggests the iPhone 18 and budget-friendly iPhone 18e could share 6.3-inch displays, 4,430mAh batteries and versions of Apple’s A20 chip. The standard model may offer a 120Hz screen and dual cameras, while the 18e could have a 60Hz display. Both are reportedly planned for spring 2027.

item.title: BGMI 4.7 with Arctic Chronicles update: Giant serpent and frozen battlegrounds - Check new features
item.description: BGMI 4.7 is a major winter-themed update that changes the gameplay experience with a mythical serpent, new map environments, frozen locations, seasonal events and fresh rewards.

item.title: World’s first dual-console robotic heart bypass surgery performed in India using SSI Mantra system
item.description: India has performed the world’s first dual-console, five-arm robotic beating-heart bypass surgery at Medanta, Gurugram, using the indigenous SSI Mantra Surgical Robotic System.

item.title: GTA VI gameplay release soon: Midnight launch, PS5 and Xbox availability, Vice City map, new characters and storyline
item.description: With the midnight rollout beginning in different parts of the world, players will soon get their first opportunity to explore Leonida and experience the next chapter of the Grand Theft Auto franchise.

item.title: Google Play reveals India's best apps and games of 2026; Pronto, Wispr Flow and ScarFall 2.0 among winners
item.description: Google Play has announced its Best Apps and Games of 2026 in India, naming Adobe Premiere the Best App and Arknights: Endfield the Best Game. Homegrown apps Pronto and Zolio, along with Indian battle royale title ScarFall 2.0, also featured among this year's winners.

item.title: GTA 6 now available on Blinkit in 11 Indian cities ahead of November 19 launch: Check price and details
item.description: GTA 6 is now available on Blinkit in 11 Indian cities ahead of its global launch on November 19, with the PS5 Standard Edition priced at ₹5,999. Customers will receive a physical collectible box containing a digital download code, with select bank offers bringing the price down to ₹5,749.

item.title: Apple outage: iPhone maker rules out cyberattack, says most systems restored after internal update caused disruption
item.description: Apple reported widespread service disruptions after an internal update affected iCloud, Apple Pay and other services, but said most systems have been restored. The outage follows recent glitches affecting Microsoft, US flights and major banks, raising concerns over service reliability.

item.title: eMudhra fixes emBridge security flaw after CERT-In warns of file-system metadata exposure
item.description: CERT-In flagged a low-severity vulnerability in eMudhra’s emBridge utility affecting certain computer OS versions. An unauthenticated attacker on the same network could enumerate file and directory names, but not access or alter files, run code, or obtain cryptographic keys or token PINs.

item.title: What is iQOO 15's 4th-gen silicon anode battery technology and how does it promise longer gaming and streaming hours?
item.description: The iQOO 15 uses fourth-generation silicon anode technology in its 7,000mAh battery. The company claims it can deliver up to 10.5 hours of gaming, 32.6 hours of video streaming and 22.6 hours of social media use.&nbsp;

item.title: How do PC, PlayStation and Xbox prices compare? Assassin’s Creed Shadows costs up to ₹8,399 in India
item.description: Assassin's Creed Shadows is priced differently across PC, PlayStation and Xbox in India, with its Premium Edition costing up to ₹8,399. A long-time fan explains whether its new features, stealth mechanics and story justify the high price.

item.title: GTA 6 hacker Arion Kurtaj, who breached Rockstar with Amazon Fire Stick, pleads guilty: What happens next?
item.description: Arion Kurtaj, the hacker behind the 2022 Rockstar Games breach that leaked 90 clips of unfinished GTA 6 gameplay, has pleaded guilty to multiple cybercrimes after being released from a secure hospital.

item.title: Cyberattack hits 178 websites including CNN, BBC, Fox News and Zoom; iPhone users also targeted
item.description: A cyberattack exploited Optimizely to deliver malicious JavaScript across 178 websites, including CNN, BBC, Fox News, Zoom and HSBC. The malware targeted cryptocurrency wallets, payment card details and browser data, while also deploying iOS exploits to compromise vulnerable iPhones and iPads.
